next_step_summary: After PR #272 merged, the same March-August 2025 contract rerun did not produce a report because the local runner attempted gemini-3.6-flash, gemini-3.7-flash, and gemini-3.5-flash once each and then terminated when all three retryable attempts failed. Product-owner correction: model routing must continue in cycles rather than die after one full pass. PR #273 changes only the local real-contract runner route: retryable GeminiRateLimitError/GeminiResponseError outcomes cycle 3.6 -> 3.7 -> 3.5, wait 30 seconds after a fully failed cycle, then restart at 3.6 until a model succeeds or the user stops with Ctrl+C. Authentication/configuration failures remain terminal. Safe console status exposes only cycle/model/error class/elapsed time; no contract text, key, or provider exception body. Prompt, privacy gate, OCR scope, model list, dependencies and network destinations are unchanged. After PR #273 validation/merge, rerun the same contract and compare the resulting report against the first real run and the manual benchmark.
